Inserting it anyway does not lift that; it records an override under your name with the dispatch.

instructions.bindingsExplanation: How each bound computer's checkout compares with these files. Sync fast-forwards that checkout to its upstream; AO never sends the computer's own edits back, and a checkout that has diverged is refused rather than merged.

instructions.syncFailedOn: AO could not sync {{host}}. The computer's own words are below.
instructions.syncRefused: {{host}} has commits in its checkout that are not on the project's branch, so AO refused to fast-forward it. Someone with access to that computer has to reconcile it — AO never merges or rebases another computer's work.
